lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged CRITICAL false negative in findStoreReachingSearch (src/issues/self-contaminating-search.ts): applyToken pushed a positional token VERBATIM as a search root with no stripping of trailing shell punctuation, so the canonical space-free command-substitution form '$(grep -rl zzqqx scripts)' tokenized its root as 'scripts)' (isStoreReachingRoot correctly rejects that, since it is neither STORE_PATH nor an ancestor prefix). Root cause: the hand-rolled tokenizer only splits on whitespace and its own quote syntax, with zero notion of '$(' / ')' or backtick pairing as a wrapper to strip. Fix: added stripTrailingShellPunctuation(token), applied to every token pushed onto state.roots in applyToken -- it peels a trailing ')' while the token has strictly more ')' than '(' internally (unbalanced-closer loop, handles nested cases), and peels a trailing backtick/quote char while its total count in the token is odd (meaning that closer belongs to an enclosing wrapper, not the token's own content). Also fixed a second, independent command-position gap surfaced by the same review round's requested regression coverage: isCommandPosition's left-context allowlist (COMMAND_POSITION_CHAR_RE) did not include a backtick, so the equivalent backtick-wrapped form '`grep -rl X scripts`' was never even recognized as an invocation; added backtick to that character class. Did NOT touch the other three review-round-2 findings already filed into prd.json before this story started (US-R2-002: isCommandPosition also rejects an opening quote as a left-context delimiter, so bash -c 'grep -rl X scripts' style wrapping -- this project's own dominant oracle idiom -- evades both guardrails, plus missing env/sudo/xargs-with-flags prefixes; US-R2-003: the existing $(...) regression test at test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts:119-122 is shaped to the old broken implementation, asserting on an artificially spaced 'scripts )' that no real command has; US-R2-004: the round-1 patterns.md bullet at line ~1128 overclaims that isCommandPosition's adjacency check 'catches the $(-prefixed real invocation' when measured against a bash -c wrapper, which is actually the US-R2-002 gap) -- those are separate priority-2/3/4 stories for the next implementer(s), each independently filed with its own repro commands in prd.json's notes field. Added 4 new tests to test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts (space-free $(...) wrapper flagged, space-free backtick wrapper flagged, $(...) wrapper rooted exactly at scripts/cam/issues flagged, $(...) wrapper rooted at a legitimate non-store path NOT flagged) and 2 new tests to test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts (space-free $(...) and backtick forms both flagged through the plan-time lint rule). Did not touch prd-oracle-lint.ts or its non-test source: that module only imports and wraps findStoreReachingSearch, so fixing the shared core transparently fixes both call sites with zero duplicated logic (consistent with the US-002/US-003 design intent already recorded in patterns.md). No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo yet (checked again, same as prior stories), so appliedPatternIds is omitted. check:all is fully green: test 5861/5861 (+6 net from this story's additions), embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet all ok. This story's commit also carries the pre-existing scripts/cam/prd.json diff that was already staged-dirty at session start (the reviewer's round-2 filing of US-R2-001..004, priorities re-sequenced so US-R1-001/002 shifted to priority 5/6): that diff was not authored by this session, only committed alongside it since it was the working tree's pre-existing state.
